title: B1 synthetic probe newline mismatch
symptom: Single synthetic probe exited early because the fixture and probe both appended a line ending; observer missed the process tree.
root_cause: The fixture already contained a line ending while the probe assumed no trailing newline.
resolution: Accept exactly one optional LF or CRLF; reject double newline; emit READY before bounded observation, write once. Offline tests passed, but complete live task sequencing remains open.
prevention: Byte-for-byte fixture contract and end-to-end check of observation interval before dispatch.
